# Designing Buildings

> > The CIOB construction wiki and collaborative platform providing comprehensive knowledge on building design, construction materials, and industry best practices.

Designing Buildings is a collaborative knowledge platform maintained by the Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB), offering detailed technical guidance on construction methods, materials like Portland cement and concrete types, building services, and design processes. The platform serves construction professionals with expert-contributed content on topics ranging from structural materials to interior decoration.

## Key Topics

- CIOB (Chartered Institute of Building)
- Construction wiki and collaborative platform
- Building design and architecture
- Concrete types (Portland cement, reinforced, precast, prestressed)
- Construction materials and classification
- Building services and procurement
- Interior decoration and surface finishes
- Galvanized and galvalume steel
- Construction industry standards
- Concept drawing and design visualization
- Drainage systems
- Lightweight and high-density concrete
- Glass reinforced concrete
- Air-entrained concrete

## Construction Materials & Concrete

- [Types of concrete](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/Types_of_concrete): Reference on concrete types including Portland cement and lightweight
- [Difference Between Galvanized and Galvalume Steel](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/wiki/Difference_Between_Galvanized_and_Galvalume_Steel): Comparison of galvanized vs galvalume steel coating properties

## Building Design & Documentation

- [Concept drawing](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/Concept_drawing): Guide to concept drawing featuring Renzo Piano and The Shard examples
- [Decoration](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/Decoration): Guide to interior decoration, surface finishes and aesthetics

## Construction Services & Procurement

- [Services](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/Services): Construction services and procurement guide per UN standards

## Platform Information

- [Designing Buildings](https://www.designingbuildings.co.uk/?pojem=Drainage): Homepage for CIOB construction wiki and collaborative platform
